whole_raw_metadata.description: The model provides daily hindcasts of the circulation, temperature and salinity in Puget Sound. These hindcases are calculated using calculated tides, atmospheric forcing from the UW Atmospheric MM5 model and river forcing from real-time data sensors from the USGS.

Its text disclaims NOAA accuracy, functional suitability, liability and warranty for these data; it supplies no additional XML-access condition or reuse license. Do not invent missing UW/model terms merely because the source is a UW model.
